package.description: Music player and music library manager for Linux, Windows, and macOS

en-US.description: Music player and music library manager for Linux, Windows, and macOS
en-US.longDescription:
Quod Libet is a cross-platform audio / music management program.
It provides many ways to view your local library, and supports streaming audio and feeds (podcasts, etc.).
It has extremely flexible metadata editing and searching capabilities.
en-US.name: Quod Libet - Music Library / Editor / Player
